title: Ability of Divorced Couples to Afford HDB Flats after Sale of Matrimonial Home
what_it_is: Ability of Divorced Couples to Afford HDB Flats after Sale of Matrimonial Home

sections.label: Divorcees' rental flat demographics
sections.summary: About 60% were female and about 70% were below 50; HDB cannot determine if they previously sold a matrimonial flat.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for National Development )
sentences.text: Of these, about 60% were females and about 70% of them were below 50 years old.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for National Development )
sentences.text: As HDB does not track individuals after the sale of their HDB flat, we are unable to determine if these divorcees sold a matrimonial flat previously.

sections.label: Divorcees' public rental approvals
sections.summary: From 2019 to 2021, HDB approved about 2,800 requests from divorcees for public rental flats.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for National Development )
sentences.text: From 2019 to 2021, HDB approved about 2,800 requests from divorcees for public rental flats.
